title: Jordan Love Will Welcome Brian Flores’ Blitz-Happy Approach
completenessBasis: Full public written analysis retrieved and exhausted; article includes attributable statistical support and a quoted J.J. Watt matchup observation. No transcript/captions applicable.
currentWeekMatchupsIdentified: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings
materialItemsExtracted: Counter-mechanism to the existing Vikings-pressure thesis: Minnesota blitzed at a 48% rate in 2025, but Love was elite specifically against Cover 0, posting a 92.2 PFF grade, avoiding sacks on all 24 Cover 0 dropbacks, throwing nine touchdowns and producing a 121.0 passer rating.
J.J. Watt's attributable observation is that Brian Flores already uses Cover 0 less frequently against Love than against other quarterbacks because Love processes and defeats it well.

With Josh Jacobs on the commissioner’s exempt list and MarShawn Lloyd elevated, the author expects Green Bay to be less run-heavy than in Love's lone 2025 meeting with Minnesota, potentially increasing Love dropbacks and making the Flores-Love pressure chess match more central.
